intro.text: A young granddaughter of King Taravangian of Kharbranth.

items.text: After a highstorm, a rockslide trapped her, her nursemaids and several servants in a room of the Conclave. Taravangian asked Jasnah Kholin to Soulcast the stone blocking the door, and Jasnah freed them.
She recovered well, though afterwards she avoided the Conclave's narrower passages. That same year her grandfather gave her a portrait of himself drawn by Shallan Davar.

appearance.text: Still young enough not to need a modesty sleeve; she is looked after by several nursemaids.
